audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows disagree with the packet chart, the mirror and the content layer's own whys. The page renders Neeko winning Level 1 while whys[0] says 'Darius wins every level-1 melee fight'; it renders Neeko winning Level 6 while whys[4] says 'Level 6 belongs to Darius'; and it renders Darius winning 2+ items while whys[6] says 'At 2+ items you take over'.
audit.why: Level 1 and Level 6 are the two rows the mirror already flipped to Darius, so the two directions of this matchup currently contradict each other on both.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Skill / Neeko as matched full/content pairs — the packet order, the mirror's order and the order the whys already describe.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] sold Level 6 as a Neeko setup puzzle and phases[5]/[6] named no ability and referenced a Stormsurge spike the content layer does not build.
audit.why: Noxian Guillotine is 120/100/80s of true damage that scales with Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes its cooldown on a kill; the row Neeko actually takes is 2+ items, where her threat range exceeds the 535 Apprehend needs.
audit.corrected: phases[4] through phases[6] rebuilt on the Guillotine, the first-item waveclear flip and Apprehend's 535 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields — whys[0], whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.foe[1]/[2] — refer to Neeko's 'Pop Blossom shield' or to trading 'before your combo and shields exist'. Neeko has no shield anywhere in her kit. mid also tells you to 'clone-and-vanish out of the pull'; Shapesplitter sends a clone away from her and grants no vanish.
audit.why: The correct reason to fear the ult is that it is true damage which grows with every Hemorrhage stack you are carrying and refreshes on a kill — that is a stacks-management lesson, not a shield-piercing one.
audit.corrected: Every shield reference replaced with the Hemorrhage-scaling point; the vanish replaced with sending the clone away; report[5].t now carries Apprehend's 26s and 535 range plus the Guillotine reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].t said 'Save E to interrupt Apprehend (Pull)', and no field anywhere gave Apprehend's cooldown.
audit.why: Apprehend is a sweep-and-pull with no cast time described as interruptible, and at 26 seconds rank 1 it is the longest and most punishable cooldown in the lane — the single most useful number on the page and it was absent.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2] retitled to holding E for his step-up; 26 seconds written into dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] says 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' without naming the source.
audit.why: Decimate heals him based on champions hit by the blade — the outer edge, not the handle — so the anti-heal is specifically against that.

Instead, use Q re-blooms to shove the wave, then disguise (Inherent Glamour) and roam or recall while he is stuck farming. If you must fight, only commit when E lands first from range and he has burned Apprehend's 26 seconds, and send the W (Shapesplitter) clone wide to buy your step back.

notes: The 'Pop Blossom shield' fabrication is at its worst here — six fields told the player her ultimate grants a shield that Noxian Guillotine pierces. Neeko has no shield in her kit, and the correct read is the opposite kind of advice: the Guillotine's damage grows with the Hemorrhage stacks you are carrying and refreshes if it kills, so the lesson is stack management and never being the reset. Five chart rows were wrong in both layers at once and disagreed with the mirror on the two rows it had already flipped. Apprehend's 26-second rank-1 cooldown — the most punishable number in the lane — appeared nowhere on the page and is now in four fields.
